summary: Depth on an NSE equity with the payload shapes RMoney's web adapter accepts (audit FB-04): camelCase keys, a segment name for the segment, a book nested in Touchline as BidInfo/AskInfo lists, and a one-sided book. Today the desktop drops each (no frame); a standard 1502 event after them still gives the book.

notes: Each silence below follows a push the web publishes a Depth frame for (web.json, by script line) and the desktop does not: the desktop routes only ExchangeSegment/ExchangeInstrumentID as numbers and makes a book only from root Bids and Asks together (families/xts/streaming.rs normalise, normalise_message). FB-04, open; the harness cannot yet declare a frame the web sends and the desktop does not.
Real XTS nests a single BidInfo/AskInfo object in Touchline; the list form here is the one the audit probe used (codex/probe_family_websocket_parity.py).

deviations.reason: The desktop's Depth frame carries every Quote field, as the recorded Zerodha transcript does; this web adapter's Depth data has no average_price (_normalize_market_data, mode 3).
The desktop's Depth frame carries every Quote field, as the recorded Zerodha transcript does; this web adapter's Depth data has no last_quantity (_normalize_market_data, mode 3).
An XTS 1502 event carries no LowerCircuitLimit; the web sends lower_circuit 0 for it (message.get('LowerCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out.

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST); feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it (1794199530000).

This web adapter puts the mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). data.mode follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed in phase B by the broker's entry in lane wire's per-broker dialect switch.

This web adapter sends OI as oi only; the desktop sends open_interest beside it. open_interest follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed in phase B by the broker's dialect entry.
The desktop's Depth frame carries every Quote field, as the recorded Zerodha transcript does; this web adapter's Depth data has no total_buy_quantity (_normalize_market_data, mode 3).
The desktop's Depth frame carries every Quote field, as the recorded Zerodha transcript does; this web adapter's Depth data has no total_sell_quantity (_normalize_market_data, mode 3).
An XTS 1502 event carries no UpperCircuitLimit; the web sends upper_circuit 0 for it (message.get('UpperCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out.
